ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle through the median notch. High-intensity contiguous regions are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. High-frequency white mottling/speckling occurs at the transition zones between the dark core and white tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations (low pixel amplitude) and several larger irregular indentations concentrated on the interior segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed convex curve extending from the central notch, reaching a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel aggregates (barnacles) localized on the upper distal tips. Numerous discrete white circular spots distributed randomly across the dark central pigmented zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel tracks (rake marks) on the white background of the right lobe tip. Similar but less contrastive linear disruptions visible on the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips; visible rake marks on white pigmented areas; significant irregular tissue loss/jaggedness along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely speckled 'starfield' pattern of white spots against the dark central background, particularly concentrated in the lower central fluke area.
